RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the December 10, 2008/Agrahayana 19, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Earth Sciences; Home Affairs;
Labour and Employment; Rural Development; Science and Technology;
Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
42
Problems faced by handloom weavers
*121. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR:
SHRI N.K. SINGH:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has conducted
any survey recently to find out the
problems being faced by the weavers;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) whether Government has made any
effort to improve their lot by improving
handloom clusters, ensuring adequate
supplies of yarn to weavers and extending
health insurance cover for them; and
(d) if so, the details in this regard?
Status of implementation of Assam
Accord
*122. SHRI BIRENDRA PRASAD
BAISHYA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Union Government had
fulfilled all its obligations as committed
through the Assam Accord, 1985;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the status about each of the
obligation fulfilled till June, 2008 and to be
fulfilled, with specific time limit;
(c) whether all safeguards are provided
in terms of clause 6 of the Accord;
(d) if so, the details of status on each
safeguard promised;
(e) if not, the reasons therefor and the
target set for each;
(f) the specific promise made for the
preparation of National Register of Citizens
(NRC) during tripartite meeting held in
2005 and its status till August, 2008; and
(g) the reasons for delay and target set?
Impact of international economic
meltdown on Indian economy
†*123. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to
international economic meltdown several
Indian industries have started decreasing
their production;

43
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the details of such industries;
(c) whether these industries were
requested to reduce prices of their products
instead of decreasing or stopping
production;
(d) if so, the reaction of the industries
thereto; and
(e) the details of industries wherein
measures have been taken by Government
so far to reduce production cost?
Effect of Rupee instability on import
and export
†*124. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI SHIV ANAND TIWARI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to
instability of Rupee vis-a-vis international
currencies particularly, Dollar, Pound etc.,
the Indian Foreign Trade suffers losses from
time-to-time;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto; and
(c) the effect of said instability in the
value of Rupee on Indian import and export
in each of the financial years from 2004-05
to 2008-09?
Threat posed by illegal Bangladeshi
immigrants
*125. SHRI V . HANUMANTHA
RAO:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether with a Parliamentary Panel
expressing concern over the threat posed
by illegal Bangladeshi immigrants to nation's
internal security, Government is going to
be under pressure for identifying and
deporting them;
(b) whether the large presence of illegal
Bangladeshi immigrants poses a grave threat
to the internal security;
(c) whether recently the Rajasthan
Government has also conveyed to the
Union Government its concern over the
illegal Bangladeshi immigrants; and
(d) if so, the steps Government
proposes to take to see that all illegal
Bangladeshis are deported back to their
country?
Decline in index of Industrial
production
*126. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
SHRIMA TI SUPRIYA SULE:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether a negative growth of 3.3
per cent in intermediate goods in September
compared with 10 per cent in the
corresponding period last year pulled down
growth in the index of industrial production
to 4.8 per cent in September, 2008 as
against 7 per cent in the same month last
year;
(b) if so, what were the main reasons
and what are the steps being considered in
this regard;
(c) whether the industry has urged
Union Government to focus on small and
medium entrepreneurs to push up the
industrial production; and
(d) if so, what are the other concrete
measures Government proposes to take in
this regard?

44
Award money for bravery in different
States
*127. SHRI DARA SINGH: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
varying rewards for identical honours are
creating tension and frustration within the
armed forces and need to be examined by
his Ministry in the interest of soldiers;
(b) whether Government has so far
consulted State Governments to
standardise cash grants given to gallantry
award winners; and
(c) if so, whether Government has laid
down the minimum cash grant to be given
to gallantry awardees by the State or left it
to the choice of States concerned?
Atrocities against women
*128. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the State-wise number of cases of
atrocities against women registered during
the years 2006-07, 2007-08 and 2008-09;
and
(b) the present status of those cases?
Purchase of land by a private company
on Pakistan border
†*129. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether any private company has
purchased hundreds of acres of land
adjoining Pakistan in the border district of
Barmer;
(b) if so, the objective of the company
for purchasing of such land alongwith the
name thereof;
(c) whether such purchase is likely to
pose security threats on the Rajasthan
border; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Rehabilitation of rescued children
*130. SHRI VIJAY JAW AHARLAL
DARDA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the National Commission
for Protection of Child Rights has asked
State Governments to take immediate steps
to check child labour and rehabilitation of
rescued children;
(b) whether the Commission has also
asked State Governments to evolve a code
of conduct for the employees of public
institutions, Government undertakings,
Government funded institutions and
Government offices for not engaging
children as domestic workers or encourage
child labour in any form al their work places;
(c) if so, the other main points
mentioned in the report; and
(d) the States that have followed these
instructions and to what extent it has been
fully implemented by them?
Rehabilitation of victims of 2004 flood
in Assam
*131. KUMAR DEEPAK DAS: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether all the victims of 2004
devastating flood in Assam have now been
rehabilitated and provided with dwelling
units;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

45
(b) if  not, the number of those still not
provided with dwelling units, district-wise;
(c) the time likely to be taken to
complete the task of rehabilitation and relief
to all the victims; and
(d) the Central assistance so far
provided to the State Government for 2004
floods, unit-wise and whether it has been
utilized completely?
Relief measures for exporters
*132. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
SHRIMATI SUPRIYA SULE:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry is seeking
export relief measures as there has been
downfall in exports;
(b) whether the Ministry has come to
the conclusion that the problem exporters
face primarily relate to the non-payment
or delayed payment;
(c) if so, whether Government has
considered this and has prepared some
mechanism to meet this; and
(d) if so, to what extent credit support
to exporters has been provided and to what
extent it has helped exporters?
Decline in export of textiles and
garments
*133. SHRI T.T.V . DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether export of textiles and
garments has decreased in the last six
months;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government is aware that
many workers have lost their jobs in the
textile cities like Tirupur in Tamil Nadu,
etc.; and
(d) if so, what action has been taken in
this regard?
Need for labour intensive economic
development policy
†*134.SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI SHIV ANAND TIW ARI:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that now there is
a need to adopt labour intensive economic
development policy in the country;
(b) if so, reaction of Government
thereto;
(c) whether Government has prepared
the draft of any new policy in this regard;
and
(d) if so, the outline of the proposed
draft?
Weekly dissemination of price based
on WPI
*135. SHRI N.K. SINGH : Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY   be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is
contemplating to discontinue weekly
dissemination of prices based on the
Wholesale Price Index (WPI); and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

46
Increase in allocation for
NREGS
*136. SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
SHRIMA TI SUPRIYA SULE:
 Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT   be pleased to state:
(a) whether in view of the growing
popularity of the employment scheme
under the National Rural Employment
Guarantee Act (NREGA), Centre has
increased allocation for scheme by
whopping Rs. 10,500 crores for the current
financial year in addition to the budgetary
provision of Rs. 16,000 crores;
(b) whether CAG in its report had
pointed out that performance of NREGS
is not satisfactory;
(c) if so, the steps taken to remove the
irregularities pointed out by the CAG; and
(d) other steps and concrete measures
taken to implement the scheme so that it
benefits the people for which it was
introduced?
Damages due to recent floods in
Andhra Pradesh
*137. SHRIMATI T. RA TNA BAI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS   be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been damage to
crops due to the recent floods in many
States, especially in the coastal areas of
East and West Godavari and
Vishakhapatnam in Andhra Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise
during the last four years;
(c) the amount of funds allocated
and released during the last four years,
State-wise; and
(d) the steps Government would take
to prevent heavy loss of  life and property
in such cases?
Infilteration in the army
*138. SHRI R. C. SINGH: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some of the
top serving army officers were found to be
involved in the Malegaon blast episode;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has any
proposal to probe into the alleged Hindutva
infiltration in army having its disturbing
implications for national security; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Transport subsidy scheme
*139. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is
implementing transport subsidy scheme to
attract investors in 14 States and UTs;
(b) if so, the aims and objectives of the
above scheme;
(c) the details of expenditure incurred
under this scheme since its inception,
year-wise and State-wise;
(d) whether it is a fact that the Planning
Commission is also evaluating the scheme
to introduce the necessary safeguards to
prevent the possible leakage and misuse;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

47
Bomb blasts in various parts of the
country
†*140. SHRI SHIVANAND TIWARI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that bomb blasts
have been carried out by terrorists in various
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 4th December, 2008 Secretary-General.
Agrahayana 13, 1930 (Saka)
parts of the country during the period from
March, 2004 to November, 2008;
(b) if so, the number of incidents related
to these bomb blasts;
(c) the number of accused persons till
date who are involved in these incidents
and number of accused persons against
whom cases have been filed in courts; and
(d) the number of accused persons who
have been found guilty till date?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
